definitions.explanation: Not giving up easily; continuing to try despite difficulties or opposition.

examples.japanese: {粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}い{交渉|こうしょう}で{契約|けいやく}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: We secured the contract through persistent negotiation.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}く{練習|れんしゅう}を{続|つづ}けた。
{成功|せいこう}するには{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}さが{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.notes: {粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}さ = tenacity (noun form)

notes:
FORMATION:
{粘|ねば}り (stickiness) + {強|づよ}い (strong)

The image is of something sticky that won't let go.

FORMS:
・{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}くない - not tenacious (negative)
・{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}くて - tenacious and... (te-form)
・{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}かった - was tenacious (past)
・{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}く + verb - tenaciously (adverb)
・{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}さ - tenacity (noun)

COLLOCATIONS:
・{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}く{交渉|こうしょう}する - to negotiate persistently
・{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}く{説得|せっとく}する - to persuade persistently
・{粘|ねば}り{強|づよ}い{努力|どりょく} - persistent effort

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{我慢強|がまんづよ}い - patient, enduring (emphasizes bearing hardship)
・しつこい - persistent (often negative)
・{諦|あきら}めない - not giving up
